title: Get social!
description: Walking with friends or family is a great way to get support and stay motivated!

title: Set a reminder
description: Use the app to set a reminder at a time of day that you want to get walking.

title: Keep track!
description: Check back regularly to see your progress and keep you motivated to help reach your goals.

title: Plan ahead!
description: Think about times in the day you could walk briskly for a few minutes - it might be on the school run, or the way back from work.
